column3: The Hebrew joins the soul-affliction command with “and”; BSB expresses it as a purpose, “that you may humble yourselves.”

The Hebrew uses active verbs for anointing and “filling his hand,” and repeats “garments”; BSB uses passive “is anointed and ordained” and combines the clothing description. “High” is not explicitly attached to priest in the Hebrew here.
The Hebrew repeats the atonement verb three times; BSB gives it once for the list.
The Hebrew ends with active singular “he did”; BSB uses passive “all this was done.”
